mapper.select: select dt.*, (select count(1) from dict_item di where di.type_code = dt.code) as item_count from dict_type dt order by dt.create_time desc, dt.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into dict_type(code, name, description, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{dictType.code}, #{dictType.name}, #{dictType.description}, #{dictType.status}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update dict_type set code = #{dictType.code}, name = #{dictType.name}, description = #{dictType.description}, status = #{dictType.status}, update_time = now() where id = #{dictType.id}
